subject: Re: Urgent: Marketplace usage delta and seller splitback routing
messages:
From: Li Tan <li.tan@cloudscale.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: marketplace-billing@gcp-partner.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 +0800
Subject: Marketplace billing spike / seller split mismatch - urgent

Hi Stephanie,

We identified a ~22% delta on our Dec 1-7 GCP Marketplace invoice compared to the usage reports in our ledger. The charge lines were routed to a different seller entity (Merchant ID 78-CCS instead of 92-CSA) and withheld for tax classification. Our finance team needs a reconciliation so we can remit payment — they're holding the wire until the seller splitback is corrected.

I've attached the usage_delta_report.csv and an export of the seller mapping from our side. Can you confirm:

- Why the routing changed for the period 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-07?
- Whether Redwood can issue an offset/credit or a corrected invoice so we can resume collection?

We are in APAC close-of-month and need an action plan by COB Monday SGT.

Thanks,
Li Tan
Head of Finance, CloudScale Inc.
Attachment: usage_delta_report.csv (CSV, 78KB)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Li Tan <li.tan@cloudscale.com>, GCP Marketplace Billing <marketplace-billing@gcp-partner.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace billing spike / seller split mismatch - urgent

Thanks Li — sorry you're seeing this. Looping Marissa (billing ops) and Karthik (marketplace integrations) to triage. Quick ask for the internal team: can we get the raw marketplace ingest logs + seller mapping for 12/01-12/07 and confirm whether a listing-level SKU remap or an attribution change pushed upstream?

Proposed next steps (quick):
- Marissa: confirm whether we have an existing offset/credit playbook for seller re-route.
- Karthik: check ingest and the mapping layers (SKU->Seller) for a config change or cascade.
- Stephanie: coordinate with GCP contact and ask for the marketplace event trace (timestamped).

Li — we'll aim to deliver a triage summary within 48 hours and propose either a corrected invoice or immediate offset credit.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Manager, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Li Tan <li.tan@cloudscale.com>, GCP Marketplace Billing <marketplace-billing@gcp-partner.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace billing spike / seller split mismatch - urgent

Stephanie / Karthik — preliminary findings attached. I pulled the ingest audit for the APAC zone for 12/01-12/07 and matched tokenized usage lines to merchant routing. Notes:

- Root cause: a model SKU rename (internal change on 2026-11-30) created a transient mapping where the SKU namespace matched a legacy merchant tag. The mapping service fell back to an older seller when the new SKU was not found in cache.
- Impact: ~21.8% of billed tokens were routed to Merchant ID 78-CCS for that window.
- Temporary mitigation: we reverted SKU aliasing on 12/02 at 03:14 UTC — subsequent batches routed correctly.

Options for CloudScale:
1) Reissue corrected invoice for 12/01-12/07 and apply a credit memo against the original (preferred for accounting).
2) Issue an immediate offset/retention credit on next payout and supply a reconciliation pack (faster but leaves original invoice intact).

Attachments: GCP_evidence_bundle.zip (contains ingest logs, mapping snapshots, and checksum manifests).

Karthik — can you confirm if the marketplace event trace from the partner is available? I need the exact event ids to match our logs. Li — which path do you prefer (corrected invoice vs offset credit)? We can prepare both drafts.

—Marissa
Director, Marketplace Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: GCP Marketplace Billing <marketplace-billing@gcp-partner.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:22:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace billing spike / seller split mismatch - urgent

On Mon, 14 Dec 2026 03:48:19 +08:00, Li Tan <li.tan@cloudscale.com> wrote:
> Additional note: GCP reports the event id sequence 8471023–8471078 for the affected lines.

Stephanie / Marissa — we pulled the partner event log and confirm event ids 8471023 through 8471078 were published with a legacy seller mapping (78-CCS) caused by a SKU alias resolution fallback. The partner can accept a corrected invoice or a seller-side adjustment. Our recommended path: corrected invoice + a credit memo referencing GCP claim id GCP-CLAIM-20261214 for auditability.

We can expedite a corrected invoice if Redwood supplies the corrected line items (SKU, usage, seller id) and the desired effective dates. Please include the credit memo description to surface in the marketplace settlement.

Regards,
GCP Marketplace Billing Team
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Li Tan <li.tan@cloudscale.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marketplace-billing@gcp-partner.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 16:55:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace billing spike / seller split mismatch - urgent

Li — thank you for the patience. Summary and recommended playbook attached.

What Redwood will deliver by EOD 2026-12-16 SGT: 
- Corrected invoice (XML + human-readable) for 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-07 showing corrected seller attribution (92-CSA) and net amount.
- Credit memo referencing GCP-CLAIM-20261214 and Redwood internal credit id RC-2026-1291.
- Reconciliation pack: ingest logs, mapping snapshots, and the marketplace event id mapping for audit. (Attached as GCP_evidence_bundle.zip)

Next steps for CloudScale:
- Accept corrected invoice and apply it against the withheld payment OR accept an immediate offset in next payout (we prefer invoice + memo for clean ledgers).
- If you accept corrected invoice, confirm the billing contact and required remit details and we'll trigger the partner expedited reissue.

Action items (owners):
- Redwood billing ops (Marissa) to draft corrected invoice and credit memo.
- Marketplace integrations (Karthik) to produce per-event mapping CSV for the partner.
- CloudScale (Li) to confirm which remediation they prefer by 2026-12-17 10:00 SGT.

Thanks all — we'll close the loop as soon as CloudScale confirms.

—Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Manager, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: GCP_evidence_bundle.zip (ZIP, 4.2MB)
